targets.rawSql: WITH latest_obs AS (SELECT AVG(value) as temp FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10)), latest_forecast AS (SELECT AVG((value-32)*5/9) as temp FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10)) SELECT ABS(f.temp - o.temp) as value FROM latest_forecast f, latest_obs o

WITH forecast AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(f.timestamp/1000000)) as valid_hour, (f.value-32)*5/9 as temp_c, f.timestamp as valid_time, i.value as issue_time, CASE WHEN i.value IS NOT NULL THEN (f.timestamp/1000000 - i.value) / 3600 ELSE NULL END as lead_hours FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') f LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') i ON f.timestamp = i.timestamp AND f.location_id = i.location_id AND i.metric = 'forecast_issue_time' WHERE f.metric = 'temperature' AND f.timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND f.timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000), observations AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(value) as temp_c FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' AND timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN f.lead_hours < 3 THEN '0-3h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 6 THEN '3-6h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 12 THEN '6-12h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 24 THEN '12-24h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 48 THEN '24-48h' ELSE '48h+' END as "Lead Time", AVG(ABS(f.temp_c - o.temp_c)) as "MAE (°C)" FROM forecast f INNER JOIN observations o ON f.valid_hour = o.hour WHERE f.lead_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN "Lead Time" = '0-3h' THEN 1 WHEN "Lead Time" = '3-6h' THEN 2 WHEN "Lead Time" = '6-12h' THEN 3 WHEN "Lead Time" = '12-24h' THEN 4 WHEN "Lead Time" = '24-48h' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

WITH forecast AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(f.timestamp/1000000)) as valid_hour, (f.value-32)*5/9 as temp_c, f.timestamp as valid_time, i.value as issue_time, CASE WHEN i.value IS NOT NULL THEN (f.timestamp/1000000 - i.value) / 3600 ELSE NULL END as lead_hours FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') f LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') i ON f.timestamp = i.timestamp AND f.location_id = i.location_id AND i.metric = 'forecast_issue_time' WHERE f.metric = 'temperature' AND f.timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND f.timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000), observations AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(value) as temp_c FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' AND timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN f.lead_hours < 3 THEN '0-3h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 6 THEN '3-6h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 12 THEN '6-12h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 24 THEN '12-24h' WHEN f.lead_hours < 48 THEN '24-48h' ELSE '48h+' END as "Lead Time", (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(f.temp_c - o.temp_c) <= 2.0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) as "Accuracy %" FROM forecast f INNER JOIN observations o ON f.valid_hour = o.hour WHERE f.lead_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN "Lead Time" = '0-3h' THEN 1 WHEN "Lead Time" = '3-6h' THEN 2 WHEN "Lead Time" = '6-12h' THEN 3 WHEN "Lead Time" = '12-24h' THEN 4 WHEN "Lead Time" = '24-48h' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

WITH forecast AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN (value-32)*5/9 END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), observations AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(f.hour, o.hour) as time, f.temp as "Forecast", o.temp as "Actual" FROM forecast f FULL OUTER JOIN observations o ON f.hour = o.hour ORDER BY time

WITH forecast AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN (value-32)*5/9 END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), observations AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT f.hour as time, (f.temp - o.temp) as "Error" FROM forecast f INNER JOIN observations o ON f.hour = o.hour ORDER BY time

WITH forecast AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wind_speed' THEN value * 1.60934 END) as wind FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), observations AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wind_speed' THEN value END) as wind FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(f.hour, o.hour) as time, f.wind as "Forecast", o.wind as "Actual" FROM forecast f FULL OUTER JOIN observations o ON f.hour = o.hour ORDER BY time

WITH forecast AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'relative_humidity' THEN value END) as humidity FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-forecast-hourly/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), observations AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as hour, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'relative_humidity' THEN value END) as humidity FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(f.hour, o.hour) as time, f.humidity as "Forecast", o.humidity as "Actual" FROM forecast f FULL OUTER JOIN observations o ON f.hour = o.hour ORDER BY time
